newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN POST WORKERS TO STRIKE THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN POST WORKERS TO STRIKE THURSDAY.

text.p: Much of Belgium's postal service is expected to be disrupted for 24 hours from 2000 GMT on Thursday because of a strike by the main post workers union.
The union represents more than half the Post Office's 45,000 workers.
Post Office spokesman Fred Lens said it was impossible to assess the likely impact of the strike, but noted it was timed to hit the start of shifts at the main sorting offices.
He said, however, newspaper deliveries should normally be only slightly affected as they are distributed directly to local post offices and not via the main sorting offices.
During past strikes, most of the country's 1,600 post office counters have also stayed open, operating on skeleton staff, he noted.
